description.value: PAUL Le Café is a Vancouver location of the venerable French bakery and café chain founded in 1889, bringing a refined European café atmosphere to downtown Vancouver. The restaurant side of the operation leans upscale, offering high tea, a Martini Society with weekly off-menu cocktails, and regular live music evenings with candlelight. It is a sit-down destination café rather than a quick-stop, with indoor seating and no outdoor patio.
